location.site: Wallula Gap Business Park, Attalia UGA / Wallula Gap area, southeast of the Tri-Cities along US-12
location.site_evidence: Walla Walla County's Amazon Data Center FAQ identifies the project land as 554 acres in the Wallula Gap Business Park; local reporting describes the business park as southeast of the Tri-Cities on Highway 12.

status_as_of_cutoff: local process: Walla Walla County's Amazon Data Center FAQ, last updated 2026-06-24, confirms the Port of Walla Walla approved sale of 554 acres in Wallula Gap Business Park to Amazon Data Services on 2026-02-12 and lists TRC26-13 pre-application materials plus a 2026-06-23 Notice of Incomplete Application for SDP26-01/SEPA26-05. Reviewed sources support proposed/planning-stage status, not approved-permitted, construction, energization, partial live, or full buildout.
evidence_grade: B+: official county FAQ verifies owner, land-sale approval, zoning/process posture, pre-application record, and incomplete SDP/SEPA application; local/trade sources corroborate full-campus scale. MW capacity, final permit approval, construction start, utility interconnection, and energization were not verified.

actions.result_status: Contemporaneous regional reporting said the Port Commission was considering sale of about 500 acres at Wallula Gap Business Park to Advance Phase LLC for a proposed $4.8 billion, 16-building data-center campus.
actions.access_caveat: GovTech republishes Tri-City Herald reporting; used for 2024 proposal context where the official agenda packet was not directly retrieved in this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Supports original announced/local-process context, not construction.

actions.government_body: Port of Walla Walla / Walla Walla County Community Development
actions.result_status: County FAQ states the Port of Walla Walla approved sale of 554 acres in Wallula Gap Business Park to Amazon Data Services.
actions.access_caveat: County FAQ links to Port minutes and summarizes the approval; sale approval is not a county development permit or construction-start record.
actions.evidence_note: Supports owner/entity update from unknown/Advance Phase to Amazon Data Services.

actions.result_status: County FAQ lists the first PreApplication Meeting for TRC26-13 on 2026-04-29 and links application, questions, site plan, survey, and project information request materials dated April 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Pre-application materials are not permit approval.

actions.result_status: County FAQ lists a Notice of Incomplete Application for Site Development Permit SDP26-01 and SEPA review SEPA26-05 dated 2026-06-23.
actions.access_caveat: The linked NOIA PDF could not be independently extracted in this refresh, but the official county FAQ directly lists the notice and case numbers.
actions.evidence_note: An incomplete application is not an approval; it keeps the project in local process.

actions.government_body: Amazon Web Services / Walla Walla County Community Development posting
actions.result_status: County FAQ posts an Amazon-hosted open house on 2026-08-11 at Columbia High School in Burbank and says it is not a public hearing or county-required/sponsored event.
actions.access_caveat: Public outreach is not a permit action.

capacity_mw_note: No official MW, IT critical load, utility interconnection capacity, or energized capacity was found. Public sources describe project cost, acreage, building count, square footage, water estimates, and energy-impact concerns but do not provide a verified campus MW.
owner: Amazon Data Services, Inc. / Amazon Web Services (AWS)

project_scope.full_campus_reported: Regional/trade reporting describes a planned 16-building campus developed in four phases, each with four roughly 215,000-square-foot buildings, totaling more than 3.4 million square feet.
project_scope.current_application_reported: A July 31, 2026 SEPA comment letter describing Amazon's submitted materials says the Attalia Campus materials cover a 134-acre campus with three one-story data-center buildings, a security building, water-treatment building, electrical substation, evaporation ponds, and septic drain field; the letter says the first environmental-review phase considers Data Center A plus the security and water buildings.
project_scope.scope_caveat: The 16-building/full-campus concept and the 3-building/134-acre application-stage materials appear to describe different planning layers or phases; no final approved site plan or buildout permit was verified.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.topic: application status wording on county FAQ
contradictions.description: The county FAQ page lists TRC26-13 pre-application materials and a 2026-06-23 Notice of Incomplete Application for SDP26-01/SEPA26-05, but a lower FAQ answer still says Community Development has not received applications. Treated as stale FAQ wording; status remains local process/incomplete application rather than approved-permitted.

Full-campus public reporting describes 16 buildings across 554 acres, while SEPA-comment materials describe a current 134-acre Attalia Campus submittal with three one-story data-center buildings and first-phase review focused on Data Center A plus support buildings. The discrepancy is retained as phase/scope ambiguity until official application documents are fully retrievable.
